text: [37] sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu cittaṃ vase vatteti no ca bhikkhu cittassa vasena vattati . katamehi sattahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu samādhikusalo hoti samādhissa samāpattikusalo hoti samādhissa ṭhitikusalo hoti samādhissa vuṭṭhānakusalo hoti samādhissa kallitakusalo 2 hoti samādhissa gocarakusalo hoti samādhissa abhinihārakusalo hoti . imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu cittaṃ vase vatteti no ca bhikkhu cittassa vasena vattatīti .
